boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost, student-accessible ways to connect, get help, or spend time on Molloy’s Rockville Centre campus.

cards.title: Book a Tutoring Services session
cards.subtitle: Public Square, Molloy University
cards.notes: Request a session when you and classmates want focused course support; appointments may be one-to-one or in a small group.
cards.short_summary: Free academic support in person or online for Molloy students.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy states that its tutors assist students free of charge and offer one-to-one or small-group sessions.
cards.access_notes: For Molloy students requesting academic support; sign up through TracCloud.

cards.title: Drop into the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Bring a draft or course question and use the walk-in Learning Commons with friends before separating for individual help.
cards.short_summary: Walk-in writing and subject-tutoring support in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy describes the Learning Commons as walk-in assistance for writing and subject tutoring, with no appointment necessary.
cards.access_notes: Molloy’s student handbook states students have free access to trained tutors; walk-in availability is scheduled.

cards.title: Meet at the Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Molloy University
cards.notes: Set up a writing session with a friend before submitting a paper, then compare revision plans after meeting with a tutor.
cards.short_summary: Free writing support for enrolled STAP students.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy states that Writing Center sessions are available free of charge to enrolled STAP students.
cards.source_title: St. Thomas Aquinas Program | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Available free of charge to enrolled students in the St. Thomas Aquinas Program.

cards.title: Join an Access discussion group
cards.subtitle: Center for Access and Disability, Molloy University
cards.notes: If you use Access services, ask the center about discussion groups and invite an eligible classmate to attend alongside you.
cards.short_summary: Optional peer-oriented support through Molloy’s Access center.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists Access Discussion Groups as an optional service provided at no additional cost to Access students.
cards.source_title: Center for Access and Disability | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: For students approved for accommodations through the Center for Access and Disability.

cards.title: Connect through Student Contacts
cards.subtitle: Center for Access and Disability, Molloy University
cards.notes: Ask Access staff about Student Contacts when you want a peer connection while navigating classes, routines, and campus resources.
cards.short_summary: An optional peer-contact service for eligible Access students.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists Peer Contacts (Student Contacts) among optional Access services at no additional cost.
cards.source_title: Center for Access and Disability | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: For students approved for accommodations through the Center for Access and Disability.

cards.title: Schedule Access academic coaching
cards.subtitle: Center for Access and Disability, Molloy University
cards.notes: Use an academic-coaching conversation to make a plan, then share the next-step checklist with a trusted eligible study partner.
cards.short_summary: Optional academic planning support through Molloy Access.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies Academic Coaching as an optional service offered at no additional cost to Access students.
cards.source_title: Center for Access and Disability | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: For students approved for accommodations through the Center for Access and Disability.

cards.title: Use the Student Counseling Center
cards.subtitle: Public Square 030, Molloy University
cards.notes: Make an individual appointment when you need a confidential, supportive conversation; the center also provides information and resources.
cards.short_summary: No-cost confidential counseling for enrolled Molloy students.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy says enrolled part-time and full-time students can access Student Counseling Center services at no cost.
cards.source_title: Student Counseling Center FAQ | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Available to currently enrolled Molloy students; appointments and support information are available through the center.

cards.title: Read course materials through E-Reserves
cards.subtitle: James E. Tobin Library, Molloy University
cards.notes: Coordinate a quiet reading session around assigned reserve material, then use the library space to discuss course takeaways afterward.
cards.short_summary: Free electronic reserve access for authorized Molloy users.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy states that authorized access to E-Reserve materials is available free of charge to faculty and students.
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to current Molloy students, faculty, administrators, and staff with active credentials.

cards.title: Use a Main Reference Room computer
cards.subtitle: James E. Tobin Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: If you are a Molloy alum visiting campus, ask the librarian for guest credentials and work side by side on a shared project.
cards.short_summary: Free library-computer use for visiting Molloy alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy’s library policy says alumni may use computers in the Main Reference Room free of charge.
cards.access_notes: For Molloy alumni; obtain a visitor pass from Public Safety first and request guest login credentials from a librarian.

cards.title: Take a Summer Immersion Program session
cards.subtitle: Molloy University, Rockville Centre
cards.notes: Eligible incoming students can use the two-week session to meet classmates while completing a listed remedial requirement before term begins.
cards.short_summary: A free two-week academic session for specified incoming students.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy’s Fall 2026 registration packet states that the Summer Immersion Program offers free two-week sessions for listed remedial requirements.
cards.access_notes: Limited to students assigned specified MAT0710, ENG1010, or ENG1000 remedial requirements; confirm placement with The Hub.
